items.title: MicroSafe-RL – Deterministic 1.18µs safety layer for Edge AI
items.raw_excerpt:
I built MicroSafe-RL to solve the "hardware destruction" problem during Reinforcement Learning and Edge LLM deployment. The Tech: It’s a bare-metal C++ interceptor using an EMA+MAD stability metric derived from Control Lyapunov Functions.
Performance: 1.18 microseconds worst-case execution time (WCET). No heap, no dynamic allocation, just 24 bytes of state.
The "Bridge": The latest update includes a Python-C++ bridge to use local LLMs (like Gemma 4 via Ollama) as robotic controllers while keeping them physically safe. Currently under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems. GitHub: https://github.com/Kretski/MicroSafe-RL

excerpt_i18n.en: In the era of virtual agents, models have achieved leapfrog development by leveraging text, image, and video data, with language and visual intelligence maturing. However, when AI truly enters the physical world and aims to enable robots to work as dexterously as humans, it must handle diverse tasks in open-world scenarios with interaction. Thus, from a more fundamental capability perspective, embodied intelligence requires not just video or language-level skills, but the ability to perceive, act, and interact in real life, continuously thinking and iterating based on physical feedback. This means embodied intelligence must learn not from a video clip, but from natural and diverse Human Data in real life. Today, Jianzhi officially launches Gen DAS Dex (hereinafter referred to as Dex)—achieving high-precision reconstruction of full-modal perception and behavior of the human hand. Combined with Ego, it revolutionizes the "Human Data" paradigm, providing embodied intelligence with a dexterous behavioral data foundation that covers "head + hand" full-scene, fine-grained, and directly trainable scenarios. 01 Why does today’s embodied intelligence need a "hand" like Dex? The human hand, with its five fingers evolved over millions of years, consists of 27 bones, 34 muscles, and 24 degrees of freedom.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la era de los agentes virtuales, los modelos han logrado un desarrollo exponencial basándose en datos de texto, imágenes y vídeo, alcanzando la madurez en inteligencia lingüística y visual. Sin embargo, cuando la IA se adentra en el mundo físico y busca que los robots trabajen con la destreza humana, es necesario abordar tareas diversas en escenarios de mundo abierto con interacción. Por tanto, desde una perspectiva de capacidades más fundamentales, la inteligencia encarnada requiere no solo el nivel de vídeo/lenguaje, sino también la capacidad de percibir, actuar e interactuar en la vida real, reflexionando e iterando continuamente según la retroalimentación física. Esto implica que lo que la inteligencia encarnada debe aprender no es un simple vídeo, sino la vida real misma.

On April 2, 2026, during the ODCC Spring Plenary, the UALink ecosystem achieved a significant milestone. At the ODCC plenary meeting, Guo Liang, leader of the ODCC New Testing Group and senior engineer at the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, together with Wang Wei, ODCC executive committee member and senior director of Alibaba Cloud server R&D, jointly launched the UALink testing and verification service. They also disclosed the current internal test results of IP interoperability verification, marking the steady progress of UALink technology from standard specifications to industrial implementation.

The UALink testing and verification service released by ODCC is built on the UALink 1.0 specification. It validates core functions such as interconnect IP, link protocols, transaction interactions, and data transmission, ensuring compatibility and interoperability of switch chips and interface IP from different vendors in Scale Up networking. The UALink service provides a fair and impartial third-party technical testing and product certification service for the domestic UALink ecosystem, offering not only official technical specifications but also verified test results. This establishes a unified basis for UALink-compatible hardware R&D, third-party testing, procurement selection, and customer acceptance within the industry ecosystem.

In a video address during the launch ceremony, Kurtis, chairman of the UALink Alliance, stated: "Protocol verification is one of the key elements in developing and establishing an open ecosystem. We thank ODCC for collaborating with the UALink Alliance to launch the UALink testing and verification service in China, ensuring through testing that UALink components are interoperable when connected."

Además, revelaron los resultados actuales de las pruebas internas de interoperabilidad de IP, lo que marca que la tecnología UALink está avanzando firmemente desde la estandarización hacia su implementación industrial. El servicio de verificación y pruebas de UALink lanzado por ODCC se basa en la especificación UALink 1.0 y cubre aspectos clave como la interconexión de IP, protocolos de enlace, interacciones transaccionales y transferencia de datos.

excerpt_i18n.en: Currently, many employees at major tech companies are grappling with a blend of old and new anxieties. "I used to think I was the backbone of my department's operations, but last month, I used an AI tool to complete an analytical report in half a day that previously took me a week of focused work. That's when I realized this is a dimensionality-reduction strike," a strategy professional from a major company in East China, nearing age 35, recently lamented to Leiphone. Over the past two years, amid waves of AI innovation, the atmosphere in the office buildings of major tech hubs like Beijing's Xierqi and Houchangcun, as well as Shenzhen's Shennan Avenue, has shifted. The lingering fear of "layoffs at age 35" has not yet dissipated, while a new, more imminent anxiety—"AI replacement"—has emerged. Game designers, front-end programmers, testers, customer service representatives... waves of positions have been hit hard by AI-driven layoffs. Since the beginning of this year, various office AI agents have further expanded the scope of this "AI replacement" panic. First, the open-source AI agent OpenClaw sparked a nationwide learning frenzy, followed by the tech giant Anthropic introducing Claude Computer Use technology, which takes over computer desktops via a "visual route," even more aggressively than OpenClaw. "Now I'm not just anxious about AI," a senior product manager said with a wry smile, "but also about the younger colleagues who are better at using AI than I am." From competing over who can work harder to competing over who can better utilize AI agents, the focus of competition between individuals and companies has begun to shift. Even in some major Shenzhen-based firms...
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, muchos empleados de grandes empresas están experimentando una angustia entre la ansiedad antigua y la nueva. "Antes siempre pensaba que era el pilar fundamental que sostenía las operaciones del departamento, hasta que el mes pasado, usando herramientas de IA, completé en medio día un informe de análisis que antes me llevaba una semana de trabajo intenso, y me di cuenta de que esto es un golpe demoledor", comentó recientemente un estratega de una gran empresa del este de China, próximo a los 35 años, a Leifeng.com. En los últimos dos años, bajo el impacto de sucesivas olas de innovación en IA, el ambiente en los edificios de oficinas de las grandes empresas en Xierqi y Houchangcun en Beijing, y en la Avenida Shennan en Shenzhen, ha cambiado: la "crisis de despidos a los 35 años" aún no se ha disipado en la mente de todos, y una nueva ansiedad, más apremiante —la "sustitución por IA"— ha llegado.
